title: Terminal panes never shift right: find why a session's terminal sometimes renders ~53pt in from the left and clipped on the right, and fix it

fields.why: Intermittent layout bug TJ hit; needs reproduction in the app

text: Screenshot: /Users/tj/Desktop/Screenshot 2026-11-11 at 3.56.39 PM.png. Terminal content starts ~53pt in with a dark band left of it and is clipped on the right; the pane header spans full width. Cause unknown, 'sometimes'. Code: SessionsView.swift TerminalHost/TerminalContainer (one session.view reparented between containers; placed only in show() and setFrameSize). Suspects: two hosts for one session at once, origin moving without size change. Reproduce first. Restart app with open -g, never steal focus.

fields.user_said: spin off a session for the left padding bug

text: The cause is reproduced: a pane whose header is wider than the pane puts the terminal host off its left edge, shown by a measured offset before the fix
check: manual: scratchpad repro prints the terminal host's x offset > 0 with the old layout

text: With the fix, the terminal host starts at the pane's left edge and is exactly the pane's width, even when the header overflows
check: manual: same repro against the fixed layout prints x=0 and width = pane width

text: The app builds with the change
The fix is confined to SessionsView.swift and committed by path

evidence: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-tj-agent-genlock/dc1726ac-1978-4047-a714-6344f359dc98/scratchpad/repro.swift with a header wider than a 300pt pane placed by a top-leading Layout like PaneGrid: old layout -> terminal host x=169.5 width=300. Screenshot matches: violet top stripe and terminal both start at px 53, header unshifted, header tabs cut off on the right
same repro: header clamped -> x=0.0 width=300.0; VStack(alignment: .leading) alone -> x=0.0 width=300.0
cd app && swift build -> Build complete! (42.10s)

answers.observed: pixel samples of the screenshot: stripe and terminal start at x=53px, header bg from x=2; repro x=169.5 -> 0
answers.cause: measured in the repro; that this was TJ's exact trigger is inferred from the matching stripe offset and the overflowing header
answers.absence: not reproduced in the live app; the running app was not restarted
answers.assumption: the fix holds in the real PaneGrid as in the repro's copy of its placement
answers.falsify: after relaunch, an Assistant pane with many tabs in a narrow window still shows a left band

text: Fixed in 89de1a5: header clamped to pane width + pane VStacks leading. Cause: overflowing header widened the centred VStack. Live app not yet relaunched on the build.
